description: This file defines the ReadableCustomer class, which extends CustomerEntity and implements Serializable. It manages a list of customer attributes represented by ReadableCustomerAttribute objects.

classes.name: ReadableCustomer
classes.description: A class representing a customer with a list of attributes, capable of being serialized for data transfer or storage.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the list of customer attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the list of customer attributes.
